g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Azure multi-tenant SaaS on AKS with a tenant catalog, elastic pools and Front Door custom domains

g.title: None.None.Node.29
g.text: The tenant's subdomain or own domain resolves to Front Door
The user signs in with Entra External ID; the token carries the tenant ID
Front Door, with its WAF and the tenant's certificate, reaches the cluster's internal load balancer over Private Link
The request reaches the shared app pods, spread over three zones
The app reads the tenant's tier and feature flags from App Configuration
finds the tenant's database in the catalog, then queries it in the elastic pool or the premium tenant's own database
The sign-up page queues a provisioning request
creates the tenant's database in the elastic pool, registers it in the catalog, and adds the tenant's domain to Front Door
